1. Create backend/src/schemas/ directory with per-domain Zod schema files, export via index.ts registry.
2. Add backend/src/middleware/validation.ts exporting a validateRequest(schema) Fastify preHandler for body/params/query.
3. Extend existing backend/src/middleware/sanitization.ts with safer HTML-escaping logic (keep existing hook, no DOMPurify dependency bloat).
4. Add backend/src/utils/validationErrors.ts to format ZodError into consistent AppError-based responses using existing errors.ts.
5. Derive TypeScript types from schemas via z.infer, re-exported from backend/src/types/index.ts.
6. Migrate 2-3 representative existing routes to use validateRequest as a proof of pattern, not all routes.
7. Add rate-limit option hook using existing fastify-rate-limit if present, otherwise skip (avoid new dependency).
8. Add tests under backend/tests/ for schema validation and sanitization edge cases (XSS, injection payloads).
9. Document schema/middleware conventions in backend/src/schemas/README.md.
10. Keep scope to backend only; no frontend or tenantValidation.ts changes required.
